meta.name: ulw-execute
meta.description: Executes a written ulw-plan work plan with Boulder state, evidence ledger, worktree discipline, and parallel subagents. Use when the user says ulw-execute or asks to run a .omo/plans plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把写好的工作计划自动跑完,并行分工并留存每一步执行证据
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手里有写好的工作计划,想让多个子任务并行落地并留下记录。
copy.tagline_en: Run a written work plan end to end with parallel subtasks and recorded evidence.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a written work plan and want its subtasks run in parallel.

howto.what: 它让 Claude 只当编排者:自己不改产品文件,而是读 .omo/plans 里的计划,把每个待办拆成子任务派给并行子代理执行,并维护 .omo 状态、证据与 worktree,直到所有复选框完成。
howto.when: 当你输入 ulw-execute,或要求运行 .omo/plans 里的计划时接管;若没有可用计划,会先调用 ulw-plan 生成计划再继续。

say.text: 执行 .omo/plans 里的这个计划
say.note: 先选计划,再把任务派给子代理

say.text: 用 --make-pr 跑这个计划,每个阶段开一个 PR
say.note: 每阶段推送分支并开 PR 交付

say.text: 用 --ship 执行并盯到 PR 合并
say.note: 盯 CI 与评审,合并后清理 worktree

howto.what_en: Claude acts only as an orchestrator: it reads a plan under .omo/plans, splits each todo into sub-tasks for parallel subagents, and keeps .omo state, evidence, and worktrees until every checkbox is done. It never edits product files.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you type ulw-execute or ask to run a plan under .omo/plans. If no plan exists, it first calls ulw-plan to create one.

say_en.note: Picks the plan, then delegates tasks

say_en.text: Run this plan with --make-pr, one PR per phase.
say_en.note: Pushes a branch and PR per phase

say_en.text: Run it with --ship and stay until the PR merges.
